title: MLOPS↔SEC-001: Model Artifact Signing + Supply-Chain Integrity
description: Security provides model-signing and integrity requirements, supply-chain integrity rules, and pipeline-security requirements; MLOps implements pipeline RBAC, artifact signing, and secrets handling to the baseline, returning conformance evidence. Grounded in SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.6 and MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.7. Model signing is part of the OTA security baseline; SEC veto can block any release weakening model signing or anti-rollback.

model_signing_required.description: Model artifacts must be signed (always true in the baseline).

supply_chain_rules.description: Supply-chain integrity rules (provenance, SBOM, pinned dependencies).

secrets_via_vault_required.description: Secrets handled via HashiCorp Vault references only — never inline.

signature_verified_at_dispatch.description: OTA dispatch verifies the model signature (links FW↔DEVOPS-001 / OTA loop).

inline_secrets_present.description: Must be false — any literal secret/key material is rejected.

model_anti_rollback_counter.description: Per-model monotonic version counter present (mitigates FC-026 model anti-rollback residual risk).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Model artifact signing and supply-chain integrity are part of the OTA security baseline behind HG-01 (SEC release veto). ESC-SEC: agents may only propose; SEC owns binding decisions. Touches FC-026 (model anti-rollback residual risk).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (baseline handoff at planning; pipeline-security implementation review; pre-production sign-off)
confirm_conditions: security_requirements pins model_signing_required = true, ≥1 supply_chain_rule, and secrets_via_vault_required = true
model_anti_rollback_counter = true (mitigates FC-026); CRITICAL/HIGH findings carry a remediation_due_date
reject_conditions: any inline_secrets_present = true (literal secret/key material — never accept; Vault references only)
artifact_signing_implemented = false on a release path (baseline violation → ESC-SEC, HG-01)
model signing or anti-rollback weakened without an ADR + SEC sign-off
counter_conditions: signing algorithm proposal differs from the device-side verifier — request FW/SEC alignment before adoption
SBOM incomplete for a transitive dependency — request completion before pre-production sign-off
